title: The 5 AM Club Is Mentored on The 10 Tactics of Lifelong Genius
coreMove: The tactics extend Victory Hour into a whole-day architecture for protected focus, concentrated work, deliberate learning, and recovery.

exampleSpecs.audience: knowledge workers interrupted by trivial communication
exampleSpecs.stakes: important work cannot deepen inside constant availability
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Tight Bubble of Total Focus physically, socially, and digitally

exampleSpecs.audience: people scattering effort across many ambitions
exampleSpecs.stakes: too many priorities prevent visible mastery
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Apply the 90/90/1 rule to one high-value project

exampleSpecs.audience: high performers equating breaks with weakness
exampleSpecs.stakes: endless strain lowers the quality of later blocks
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the 60/10 method as effort-renewal rhythm

exampleSpecs.audience: people collecting tools instead of learning
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show scheduled learning rather than vague intention

exampleSpecs.audience: leaders whose days are spent by inboxes
exampleSpecs.stakes: communication can consume the resources Victory Hour created
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Convert morning renewal into whole-day architecture

exampleSpecs.stakes: attention and recovery are scarce resources during exam season
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use tactics to protect scarce resources
